messages:
sara: FYI perf regression on nightly dash: v3 kernel selection picked a non-causal tiling that blows up latency for head_dim=48 on sm86. Repro + profile below.

leo: can you paste the perf numbers?

sara: P95 for chat gen (seqlen 2048, batch 1) went from 110ms -> 125ms (12.7%). traces show a switch from flashattn_v3_causal_tile8 to flashattn_v3_general_tile4.

maria: do we have the autotuner decision log? maybe headdim modulo fell through?

sara: yes snippet from autotuner.log:
```
[autotune] model:chat-v2, arch:sm86, seq:2048, headdim:48 -> pick: flashattn_v3_general_tile4 (score 0.82)
[autotune] fallback path: causal_mask_support:false
```

leo: weird that causal_mask_support:false — v3 supports causal. Is our causal flag flip broken in kernel handoff?

kyle: I pushed a small change earlier that removed the causal bit for kernel probe if headdim%16 != 0 to avoid sm86 warp divergence. That might be culprit.

maria: head_dim=48 %16 ==0 though. so shouldn't hit that branch.

sara: right. but our batching heuristic now sends a synthetic kv cache request with prefix padding which sets causal=false in probe.

leo: aha. so probe sees non-causal usage for the same model and picks general kernel.

maria: possible quick fix: make kernel selection consult sequence-level request flags not probe payload. Or add separate causal_probe endpoint.

kyle: I can try a patch: bump probe to carry explicit 'causal=true' if model has causal profile. Will run canary.

sara: repro script (run on an sm86 g5):
```
PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:32 python perf/repro_head48.py --model chat-v2 --seqlen 2048 --batch 1
```

apm-agent: Deploy bot: canary rolled to t2 on g5c. Monitor p95.

kyle: test results after change: p95 back to 108ms (2% faster than baseline). Putting rollout notes in PR.

leo: nice. but we should also update autotuner to consider 'kv_cache_mode' and 'inference_probe_padding'. Otherwise other models will regress.

maria: agree. Also record a regression test in perf-suite that runs head_dim in {48,56,64} for causal paths.

sara: created issue #2412 with repro, logs, and suggested fixes. tagging eng-runtime on the issue.

leo: thumbs up :thumbsup: let's keep watch for any SM80 vs SM86 divergence; I think our kernel score mapping still prefers v2 on sm80 for headdim 48 which is fine.

kyle: noted. I'll follow-up with a small perf map doc in the repo.

cicd-bot: CI: PR 4923 passed unit tests, perf checks pending.

maria: thanks all, good catch.
